#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Verificar los secretos necesarios.
: "${GITHUB_TOKEN:?Falta GITHUB_TOKEN}"
: "${RIU_API_KEY:?Falta RIU_API_KEY}"

# Autenticacion Git desde secreto de entorno.
# Nunca incluir el token en la URL del repositorio.
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=credential.helper
export GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0='!f() { printf "username=x-access-token\npassword=%s\n" "$GITHUB_TOKEN"; }; f'

# GitHub es la unica fuente del codigo.
REPO="/tmp/repo"

rm -rf "$REPO"

# El repo GitHub pesa >8 GB (agentes vendorizados); clon parcial + sparse
# excluyendo carpetas pesadas que el router no usa (antes: clone colgado >30 min).
git clone \
  --depth 1 \
  --filter=blob:none \
  --no-checkout \
  --single-branch \
  --branch main \
  https://github.com/maxbry123-commits/router-universal-router-inteligente-.git \
  "$REPO"

cd "$REPO"
git sparse-checkout set --no-cone '/*' \
  '!/chat-router/agentes/agentes-listos/' '!/chat-router/agentes/frameworks/' \
  '!/chat-router/agentes/investigacion/' '!/chat-router/chatbot/' \
  '!/chat-router/memoria/' '!/chat-router/otros/' \
  '!/chat-router/workflow-loop-code-yaiwes/'
git checkout -q main

# Verificar rama y commit.
echo "MVP_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)"
echo "MVP_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

  # La estructura nueva trae 2 raices: router-mvp/ y chat-router/.
  if [ -d router-mvp ]; then
    cd router-mvp
    export PYTHONPATH="$PWD:$PWD/../chat-router${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
  fi

  # Verificar archivos requeridos (funciona con la estructura vieja y la nueva).
  test -f mvp/run.py
  test -f mvp/app.py
  test -f mvp/requirements.txt

  # --- web-bridge en background :7870 ---
  BR="$REPO/chat-router/SWE CODE/web-bridge"; [ -d "$BR" ] || BR="$REPO/router-mvp/SWE CODE/web-bridge"
  echo "BOOT step: bridge"
  if [ -d "$BR" ] && [ -n "${WEB_ACCOUNTS:-}" ] && [ -n "${WEB_PASS:-}" ]; then
    timeout 20 mkdir -p /data/state /tmp/state "$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH"
    # perfiles Chromium en disco local (el bucket FUSE /data rompe launchPersistentContext);
    # restaurar desde /data/state y sincronizar de vuelta cada 5 min
    : "${WEB_ACCOUNTS:?Falta WEB_ACCOUNTS}"
    : "${WEB_PASS:?Falta WEB_PASS}"
    export WEB_ACCOUNTS WEB_PASS
    echo "WEB_ACCOUNTS_LEN=${#WEB_ACCOUNTS}"   # solo longitud, nunca el valor
    # State FUSE restore NO debe bloquear npm/node del bridge (antes: cp hasta 600s
    # antes de npm -> :7870 muerto -> /web 500 y chat vacio).
    ( echo "STATE restore start"; timeout 600 cp -a /data/state/. /tmp/state/ 2>/dev/null; echo "STATE restore done"
      while sleep 300; do timeout 280 cp -a /tmp/state/. /data/state/ 2>/dev/null || true; done ) 2>&1 | sed -u "s/^/[state] /" &
    ( cd "$BR" && echo "BRIDGE npm start" && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund \
        && echo "BRIDGE playwright install" && npx playwright install chromium \
        && echo "BRIDGE node start" \
        && BRIDGE_PORT=7870 BRIDGE_STATE_DIR=/tmp/state exec node src/server.js ) 2>&1 | sed -u "s/^/[bridge] /" &
    echo "BRIDGE started"
  elif [ -d "$BR" ]; then
    echo "WARN: web-bridge omitido: faltan WEB_ACCOUNTS/WEB_PASS (D-86 recuperacion)"
  else
    echo "WARN: web-bridge dir no encontrado"
  fi

  # --- puente-movil :7862 (APK WSS /agente + MCP /mcp) ---
  PM="$REPO/chat-router/SWE CODE free/puente-movil"; [ -d "$PM" ] || PM="$REPO/router-mvp/SWE CODE free/puente-movil"
  if [ -d "$PM" ] && [ -z "${PUENTE_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    echo "WARN: PUENTE_TOKEN no definido, puente omitido"
  elif [ -d "$PM" ]; then
    ( cd "$PM" && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund \
        && PUENTE_PORT=7862 PUENTE_TOKEN="$PUENTE_TOKEN" exec node server.js ) 2>&1 | sed -u "s/^/[puente] /" &
    echo "PUENTE started :7862"
  else
    echo "WARN: puente-movil dir no encontrado"
  fi

  # --- OpenClaw Gateway en background 127.0.0.1:18789 (opcional: OPENCLAW_ENABLE=1) ---
  if [ "${OPENCLAW_ENABLE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    /openclaw.sh 2>&1 | sed -u "s/^/[openclaw] /" &
    echo "OPENCLAW started"
  fi

  # --- router MVP en :7861 (proxy ocupa 7860) ---
  echo "RUNPY_PORT_LINES:"; grep -nE "PORT|port" mvp/run.py || true
  if grep -qE "environ.*PORT|getenv\(.?.?PORT" mvp/run.py; then
    PORT=7861 RIU_PORT=7861 python -m mvp.run &
  else
    echo "run.py sin PORT env -> uvicorn mvp.app:app :7861"
    python -m uvicorn mvp.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 7861 &
  fi
  ROUTER_PID=$!

  # --- proxy :7860 ---
  echo "BOOT step: proxy :7860"
  cd /
  exec python -m uvicorn proxy:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7860 --app-dir /

'''Flota del Router: hasta 10 jobs iguales de HF (cpu-basic, 16 GB, de pago).
Regla del Director: si la CPU de la flota llega a 85% se enciende otro job; una replica sin senal 5 min se apaga.
Solo el job principal (role main) guarda estado (memoria, banco, almacenamiento). Las replicas atienden solo llamadas
a modelos (/v1/...): asi nunca escriben en el deposito compartido. La flota nunca debe tumbar la puerta.'''
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import threading
import time
from typing import Any

NS = 'COMAND-CENTER-1'
MAX_JOBS = int(os.getenv('RIU_FLEET_MAX', '10'))
CPU_UP = float(os.getenv('RIU_FLEET_CPU_UP', '85'))
IDLE_S = int(os.getenv('RIU_FLEET_IDLE_S', '300'))
TICK_S = int(os.getenv('RIU_FLEET_TICK_S', '20'))
UP_TICKS = int(os.getenv('RIU_FLEET_UP_TICKS', '2'))
COOLDOWN_S = int(os.getenv('RIU_FLEET_COOLDOWN_S', '90'))
BOOT_S = 600
MAX_LAUNCHES_HOUR = 20
STATELESS = ('/v1/',)
KEEPALIVE_S = int(os.getenv('RIU_KEEPALIVE_S', str(6 * 3600)))
DOOR_URL = os.getenv('RIU_DOOR_URL', 'https://comand-center-1-claude-github-mcp-backup.hf.space')


class Fleet:
    def __init__(self, kernel, bread, bwrite, api_factory, root: str, clock=time.time) -> None:
        self.k, self.bread, self.bwrite, self.api, self.now = kernel, bread, bwrite, api_factory, clock
        self.path = f'{root}/control/router-replicas.json'
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.thread = None
        self.cpu: dict = {}
        self.hot = 0
        self.last_up = 0.0
        self.rr = 0
        self.launches: list = []
        self.last_error = None
        self.last_ping = 0.0
        try:
            self.reps: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = (self.bread(self.path) or {}).get('replicas', {})
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.reps = {}

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self.thread and self.thread.is_alive():
            return
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._loop, daemon=True, name='fleet')
        self.thread.start()

    def _loop(self) -> None:
        while True:
            try:
                self.tick()
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                self.last_error = type(exc).__name__ + ':' + str(exc)[:120]
            self._keepalive()
            time.sleep(TICK_S)

    def _keepalive(self) -> None:
        '''El Space en la maquina de 16 GB se duerme tras 48 h sin visitas: una visita propia desde afuera cada 6 h lo mantiene despierto.'''
        ahora = self.now()
        if ahora - self.last_ping < KEEPALIVE_S:
            return
        try:
            import httpx
            httpx.get(DOOR_URL + '/healthz', timeout=20)
            self.last_ping = ahora
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.last_error = 'keepalive:' + type(exc).__name__

    def _save(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.bwrite(self.path, {'replicas': self.reps})
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.last_error = 'save:' + type(exc).__name__

    def pick(self, path: str, primary_url):
        try:
            if not primary_url or not any(path.startswith(p) for p in STATELESS):
                return primary_url
            with self.lock:
                opciones = [(None, primary_url)] + [(j, r['url']) for j, r in self.reps.items() if r.get('healthy')]
                self.rr = (self.rr + 1) % len(opciones)
                job, url = opciones[self.rr]
                if job:
                    self.reps[job]['last_req'] = self.now()
                return url
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return primary_url

    def _cpu_of(self, job_id: str, out: dict) -> None:
        try:
            for m in self.api().fetch_job_metrics(job_id=job_id, namespace=NS):
                out[job_id] = float(m.get('cpu_usage_pct') or 0)
                return
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            out.pop(job_id, None)

    def _read_cpu(self, ids: list) -> dict:
        out: dict = {}
        hilos = [threading.Thread(target=self._cpu_of, args=(i, out), daemon=True) for i in ids]
        for t in hilos:
            t.start()
        for t in hilos:
            t.join(15)
        return out

    def _cancel(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        try:
            self.api().cancel_job(job_id=job_id, namespace=NS)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        self.reps.pop(job_id, None)

    def tick(self) -> None:
        ahora = self.now()
        primary = (self.k.reg or {}).get('job_id')
        for job in list(self.reps):
            r = self.reps[job]
            try:
                st = str(getattr(self.api().inspect_job(job_id=job, namespace=NS).status, 'stage', '')).upper()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                st = 'UNKNOWN'
            if st in ('ERROR', 'CANCELED', 'COMPLETED', 'DELETED'):
                self.reps.pop(job, None)
                continue
            if 'RUNNING' in st:
                try:
                    r['healthy'] = bool(self.k.healthy(r['url']))
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    r['healthy'] = False
                if r['healthy'] and not r.get('healthy_since'):
                    r['healthy_since'] = ahora
        for job in list(self.reps):
            r = self.reps[job]
            if r.get('healthy'):
                if ahora - max(r.get('last_req', 0), r.get('healthy_since', ahora)) >= IDLE_S:
                    self._cancel(job)  # 5 min sin senal: se duerme
            elif ahora - r.get('started', ahora) >= BOOT_S:
                self._cancel(job)  # nunca llego a estar sano
        ids = ([primary] if primary else []) + [j for j, r in self.reps.items() if r.get('healthy')]
        self.cpu = self._read_cpu(ids)
        valores = list(self.cpu.values())
        media = sum(valores) / len(valores) if valores else 0.0
        self.hot = self.hot + 1 if (valores and media >= CPU_UP) else 0
        total = (1 if primary else 0) + len(self.reps)
        self.launches = [t for t in self.launches if ahora - t < 3600]
        if (self.hot >= UP_TICKS and total < MAX_JOBS and ahora - self.last_up >= COOLDOWN_S
                and len(self.launches) < MAX_LAUNCHES_HOUR):
            self._scale_up(ahora)
            self.hot = 0
        self._save()

    def _scale_up(self, ahora: float) -> None:
        flavor = (self.k.reg or {}).get('flavor') or os.getenv('RIU_ROUTER_FLAVOR', 'cpu-upgrade')  # D-83
        info = self.k.launch(flavor, role='replica')
        self.reps[info['job_id']] = {'url': info['url'], 'started': ahora, 'last_req': 0, 'healthy': False, 'flavor': flavor}
        self.last_up = ahora
        self.launches.append(ahora)
        try:
            self.k._log('FLEET_UP', {'job_id': info['job_id'], 'total': 1 + len(self.reps)})
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    def status(self) -> dict:
        return {'max': MAX_JOBS, 'cpu_up_pct': CPU_UP, 'idle_s': IDLE_S, 'hot_ticks': self.hot,
                'cpu': {k[:8]: v for k, v in self.cpu.items()},
                'replicas': {j[:8]: {'healthy': r.get('healthy'), 'url': r.get('url')} for j, r in self.reps.items()},
                'error': self.last_error}
COMAND-CENTER-1/claude-github-mcp-backup.door.py:
"""Puerta fija + micro-kernel del Router Universal (Director 2026-10-03).

Este Space (pago, nunca duerme) es la DIRECCION FIJA. El Router corre en un HF Job CPU Basic (16 GB, pago, $0.01/h) cuya
direccion cambia en cada relanzamiento; la puerta reenvia cada llamada al Job vigente.
Micro-kernel (hilo de este proceso, cada 60 s):
  * sin Router vivo -> lanza uno;
  * faltan <= 20 min para vencer, 3 fallos de salud seguidos o cambio de procesador pedido -> lanza el SUCESOR,
    espera a que responda /health, cambia el registro y recien entonces cancela el anterior (nunca queda sin Router).
Registro: buckets/<HF_BUCKET_ID>/control/router-current.json  (job_id, url, flavor, started, timeout_s).
Codigo del Router: bundle en el bucket (code/router-bundle.tar.gz): el Job no usa GitHub.
La clave del Router (X-API-Key o Bearer) pasa intacta; la puerta agrega el token HF que exige el proxy hf.jobs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
import threading
import time
from typing import Any

import httpx

log = logging.getLogger("door")
BUCKET = os.getenv("HF_BUCKET_ID", "COMAND-CENTER-1/yaiwes-memoria-storage")
ROOT = os.getenv("RIU_ROOT", "router-inteligente-universal").strip("/")  # raiz unica del Router (Director 2026-10-03)
REGISTRY = f"{ROOT}/control/router-current.json"
DESIRED = f"{ROOT}/control/router-desired.json"
KERNEL_LOG = f"{ROOT}/control/kernel-log.jsonl"
BUNDLE = os.getenv("RIU_CODE_BUNDLE", f"buckets/{BUCKET}/{ROOT}/codigo/router-bundle.tar.gz")
JOB_HOURS = int(os.getenv("RIU_ROUTER_JOB_HOURS", "24"))
RENEW_BEFORE_S = int(os.getenv("RIU_ROUTER_RENEW_BEFORE_S", str(20 * 60)))
DEFAULT_FLAVOR = os.getenv("RIU_ROUTER_FLAVOR", "cpu-upgrade")  # D-83: 32 GB + CPU (cpu-basic prohibido)  # 2 vCPU / 16 GB, pago
PORT = 8000
SECRET_NAMES = ("RIU_VAULT_PASSPHRASE", "RIU_AGENT_API_KEYS", "RIU_AGENT_API_KEYS_2", "RIU_ROUTER_API_KEY", "RIU_DIRECTOR_KEY_HASH")
HOP = {"host", "content-length", "connection", "keep-alive", "transfer-encoding", "upgrade", "te", "trailer", "proxy-authorization"}


def _token() -> str:
    return os.getenv("RIU_KERNEL_HF_TOKEN") or os.getenv("HF_TOKEN") or ""


def _fs():
    from huggingface_hub import HfFileSystem

    # fresh instance, no listing cache: the registry and the desired-processor file change while this process runs
    return HfFileSystem(token=_token(), skip_instance_cache=True)


def _api():
    from huggingface_hub import HfApi

    return HfApi(token=_token())


def bread(path: str) -> Any:
    try:
        return json.loads(_fs().cat_file(f"buckets/{BUCKET}/{path}"))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return None


def bwrite(path: str, data: Any) -> None:
    _fs().pipe_file(f"buckets/{BUCKET}/{path}", json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode())


def bootstrap_command() -> list[str]:
    script = (
        "set -e; export HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1; pip install -q huggingface_hub >/dev/null; "
        "python - <<'PY'\n"
        "import io, os, tarfile\n"
        "from huggingface_hub import HfFileSystem\n"
        f"raw = HfFileSystem(token=os.environ['HF_TOKEN']).cat_file({BUNDLE!r})\n"
        "tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode='r:gz').extractall('/app')\n"
        "PY\n"
        "cd '/app/router inteligente universal' && pip install -q -r requirements.txt 'uvicorn[standard]' >/dev/null && "
        f"exec uvicorn integration.chat_mvp.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port {PORT} --timeout-keep-alive 120"
    )
    return ["bash", "-lc", script]


class Kernel:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.reg: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.fails = 0
        self.last_error: str | None = None
        self.renewing = False
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None

    # -------------------------------------------------- jobs
    def launch(self, flavor: str, role: str = "main") -> dict[str, Any]:
        tok = _token()
        secrets = {n: os.environ[n] for n in SECRET_NAMES if os.getenv(n)}
        secrets.update({"HF_TOKEN": tok, "HF_CONTROL_JOBS_TOKEN": tok})
        sb = f"buckets/{BUCKET}/{ROOT}/banco"  # banco unico dentro de la raiz del Router
        env = {"HF_BUCKET_ID": BUCKET, "RIU_DATA_DIR": "/tmp/riu", "RIU_VAULT_PATH": "/tmp/riu/riu_vault.db",
               "RIU_VAULT_SOURCE": f"{sb}/vault.db.gz.b64", "RIU_VAULT_PROVIDERS_SOURCE": f"{sb}/providers.json",
               "RIU_AUTOSYNC_SECONDS": "60", "RIU_CODE_BUNDLE": BUNDLE, "RIU_ROOT": ROOT, "RIU_FLAVOR": flavor, "RIU_JOB_ROLE": "main", "HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS": "1"}
        if role != "main":  # replicas: sin estado compartido (no escriben en el deposito ni en la memoria)
            env.update({"RIU_JOB_ROLE": role, "RIU_AUTOSYNC_SECONDS": "0"})
            env.pop("HF_BUCKET_ID", None)
        job = _api().run_job(image="python:3.12", command=bootstrap_command(), flavor=flavor, timeout=f"{JOB_HOURS}h",
                             expose=[PORT], secrets=secrets, env=env, namespace="COMAND-CENTER-1")
        info = {"job_id": job.id, "url": f"https://{job.id}--{PORT}.hf.jobs", "flavor": flavor, "started": time.time(),
                "timeout_s": JOB_HOURS * 3600}
        self._log("LAUNCH", info)
        return info

    def stage(self, job_id: str) -> str:
        try:
            return str(getattr(_api().inspect_job(job_id=job_id, namespace="COMAND-CENTER-1").status, "stage", "")).upper()
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"UNKNOWN:{type(exc).__name__}"

    def healthy(self, url: str) -> bool:
        try:
            r = httpx.get(url.rstrip("/") + "/health", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + _token()}, timeout=15)
            return r.status_code == 200
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    def wait_healthy(self, info: dict[str, Any], limit_s: int = 900) -> bool:
        end = time.time() + limit_s
        while time.time() < end:
            st = self.stage(info["job_id"])
            if "ERROR" in st or "CANCELED" in st or "COMPLETED" in st:
                return False
            if "RUNNING" in st and self.healthy(info["url"]):
                return True
            time.sleep(15)
        return False

    def cancel(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        try:
            _api().cancel_job(job_id=job_id, namespace="COMAND-CENTER-1")
            self._log("CANCEL", {"job_id": job_id})
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.last_error = f"cancel:{type(exc).__name__}"

    def renew(self, reason: str, flavor: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Successor first, switch, then cancel the old one: the door never points to nothing."""
        if self.renewing:
            return
        self.renewing = True
        try:
            old = dict(self.reg)
            new = self.launch(flavor or old.get("flavor") or DEFAULT_FLAVOR)
            new["reason"] = reason
            if self.wait_healthy(new):
                with self._lock:
                    self.reg, self.fails = new, 0
                bwrite(REGISTRY, new)
                self._log("SWITCH", {"from": old.get("job_id"), "to": new["job_id"], "reason": reason})
                if old.get("job_id") and old["job_id"] != new["job_id"]:
                    self.cancel(old["job_id"])
            else:
                self._log("SUCCESSOR_FAILED", {"job_id": new["job_id"], "reason": reason})
                self.cancel(new["job_id"])
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.last_error = f"renew:{type(exc).__name__}:{str(exc)[:160]}"
        finally:
            self.renewing = False

    # -------------------------------------------------- loop
    def tick(self) -> None:
        fresh = bread(REGISTRY)  # re-read every tick: the bucket registry is the single source of truth
        if fresh:
            self.reg = fresh
        reg = self.reg
        if not reg.get("job_id"):
            self.renew("sin router")
            return
        st = self.stage(reg["job_id"])
        if "RUNNING" not in st:
            if any(x in st for x in ("ERROR", "CANCELED", "COMPLETED", "DELETED")):
                self.reg = {}
                self.renew(f"router {st}")
            return
        self.fails = 0 if self.healthy(reg["url"]) else self.fails + 1
        desired = bread(DESIRED) or {}
        remaining = reg["started"] + reg["timeout_s"] - time.time()
        if desired.get("relaunch_now") and desired.get("flavor") and desired.get("ts", 0) > reg.get("started", 0):
            self.renew("cambio de procesador pedido", desired["flavor"])
        elif remaining <= RENEW_BEFORE_S:
            self.renew("renovacion 20 min antes de vencer", desired.get("flavor"))
        elif self.fails >= 3:
            self.renew("3 fallos de salud")

    def _loop(self) -> None:
        while True:
            try:
                self.tick()
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                self.last_error = f"tick:{type(exc).__name__}:{str(exc)[:160]}"
            time.sleep(60)

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self._thread is None and _token() and os.getenv("RIU_KERNEL_ENABLED", "1") == "1":
            self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._loop, name="router-kernel", daemon=True)
            self._thread.start()

    def _log(self, event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        line = json.dumps({"ts": time.time(), "event": event, **data}, ensure_ascii=False)
        log.warning("kernel %s", line)
        try:
            fs, path = _fs(), f"buckets/{BUCKET}/{KERNEL_LOG}"
            old = fs.cat_file(path).decode() if fs.exists(path) else ""
            fs.pipe_file(path, (old + line + "\n")[-200000:].encode())
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    def status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        reg = dict(self.reg)
        left = int(reg["started"] + reg["timeout_s"] - time.time()) if reg.get("started") else None
        return {"router": {k: reg.get(k) for k in ("job_id", "url", "flavor", "started")}, "seconds_left": left,
                "health_fails": self.fails, "renewing": self.renewing, "last_error": self.last_error,
                "renew_before_s": RENEW_BEFORE_S, "job_hours": JOB_HOURS}


KERNEL = Kernel()

try:
    from fleet import Fleet
    FLEET = Fleet(KERNEL, bread, bwrite, _api, ROOT)
except Exception as _exc:  # noqa: BLE001  la flota nunca debe tumbar la puerta
    _err = repr(_exc)[:200]

    class _SinFlota:
        def pick(self, path, primary):
            return primary

        def start(self):
            pass

        def status(self):
            return {"error": _err}

    FLEET = _SinFlota()


class Door:
    """ASGI dispatcher: MCP paths -> existing MCP app, /mini -> mini router, /door/status -> kernel, rest -> Router Job."""

    def __init__(self, mcp_app, mcp_paths: set[str], mini_app=None) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
        self.mcp_app, self.mcp_paths, self.mini_app = mcp_app, mcp_paths, mini_app
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(300.0, connect=20.0),  # 1000+ conexiones a la vez
                                        limits=httpx.Limits(max_connections=5000, max_keepalive_connections=500))
        KERNEL.start()
        FLEET.start()

    async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send):  # noqa: ANN001
        if scope["type"] == "lifespan":
            await self.mcp_app(scope, receive, send)
            return
        path = scope.get("path", "")
        norm = path[:-1] if path.endswith("/") and len(path) > 1 else path
        if scope["type"] != "http" or norm in self.mcp_paths or norm in ("/healthz", "/webhook") or norm.startswith("/.well-known"):
            await self.mcp_app(scope, receive, send)
            return
        if norm == "/door/status":
            await _json(send, 200, {**KERNEL.status(), "fleet": FLEET.status()})
            return
        if self.mini_app is not None and (norm == "/mini" or norm.startswith("/mini/")):
            await self.mini_app(scope, receive, send)
            return
        await self.proxy(scope, receive, send)

    async def proxy(self, scope, receive, send):  # noqa: ANN001
        url = FLEET.pick(scope.get("path", ""), (KERNEL.reg or {}).get("url"))
        if not url:
            await _json(send, 503, {"status": "ROUTER_STARTING", "retry_after_s": 60, "kernel": KERNEL.status()})
            return
        body = b""
        while True:
            msg = await receive()
            body += msg.get("body", b"")
            if not msg.get("more_body"):
                break
        headers = [(k.decode(), v.decode()) for k, v in scope["headers"] if k.decode().lower() not in HOP]
        auth = next((v for k, v in headers if k.lower() == "authorization"), "")
        has_key = any(k.lower() == "x-api-key" for k, _ in headers)
        headers = [(k, v) for k, v in headers if k.lower() != "authorization"]
        if auth.lower().startswith("bearer ") and not has_key:
            headers.append(("X-API-Key", auth[7:].strip()))  # client's Router key travels as X-API-Key
        headers.append(("Authorization", "Bearer " + _token()))  # hf.jobs proxy
        target = url.rstrip("/") + scope["path"] + (("?" + scope["query_string"].decode()) if scope.get("query_string") else "")
        try:
            req = self.client.build_request(scope["method"], target, headers=headers, content=body)
            resp = await self.client.send(req, stream=True)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            await _json(send, 502, {"status": "ROUTER_UNREACHABLE", "error": type(exc).__name__})
            return
        out = [(k.encode(), v.encode()) for k, v in resp.headers.items() if k.lower() not in HOP | {"content-encoding"}]
        await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": resp.status_code, "headers": out})
        try:
            async for chunk in resp.aiter_raw():
                await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": chunk, "more_body": True})
        finally:
            await resp.aclose()
        await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b"", "more_body": False})


async def _json(send, status: int, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    raw = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": status, "headers": [(b"content-type", b"application/json")]})
    await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": raw})

# Maxbry Claude GitHub Backup MCP

Independent backup path for **Claude Chat/Web**, not Claude Code.

```text
Claude Chat
   │ MCP (no HF sign-in)
   ▼
Hugging Face Docker Space (this app)
   │ dedicated GitHub PAT stored only as Space Secret
   ▼
GitHub REST API
   ▼
maxbry123-commits/* repositories
```

## Required Space Secret

Set exactly one GitHub credential in the Space **Settings → Variables and secrets**:

- `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` = dedicated GitHub PAT for this backup MCP.

Never commit the PAT to this repository, a README, a workflow, or a Claude conversation.

## Optional Space variable

- `GITHUB_DEFAULT_OWNER=maxbry123-commits`

## Claude custom connector

Use:

- Name: `GitHub Backup HF`
- MCP URL: `https://comand-center-1-claude-github-mcp-backup.hf.space/mcp`
- Requires sign-in: **ON** (Hugging Face OAuth)

## Verification order

1. `connection_status`
2. `list_repositories`
3. `get_file` on `agentes`, branch `claude-mcp-write-test`
4. `create_or_update_file` only under `claude-mcp-tests/`
5. `delete_file` only on `claude-mcp-tests/DELETE_ME.md`
6. Verify resulting commit SHAs from GitHub before using the connector on real work.

## Capability

Convenience tools cover repository listing, file read/write/delete, branch create/delete, issue creation, PR creation and repository deletion. `github_api` is the full REST fallback for operations not wrapped by a convenience tool. Effective authority is limited by the GitHub PAT stored in the Space secret.

---

# Router Universal: puerta fija, micro-kernel y mini router (2026-10-03)

Este Space (pago, nunca duerme) es ademas la **direccion fija del Router Universal**. El MCP de GitHub de arriba sigue igual en sus rutas secretas.

```text
Cliente (UI, chat, Harness, agentes, SDK)
   │  https://comand-center-1-claude-github-mcp-backup.hf.space/<ruta del Router>
   ▼
Puerta fija (door.py, este Space)  ──>  Router Universal en HF Job CPU Basic (16 GB, pago, $0.01/h)
   │ micro-kernel cada 60 s                │  banco abierto, memoria, fichas, laboratorio, MCP, puente HF
   │ relanza 20 min ANTES de vencer        ▼
   │ sucesor primero, luego apaga viejo   Bucket HF COMAND-CENTER-1/yaiwes-memoria-storage (permanente)
   └─ /mini/* mini router L4/T4 (mini.py)
```

## Como conectarse (sin tocar el Router)
| Para | URL | Clave |
|---|---|---|
| OpenAI / Harness / SDK | `https://comand-center-1-claude-github-mcp-backup.hf.space/v1/router` (model `auto`, un grupo o `proveedor:modelo`) | Bearer o X-API-Key = clave del Router |
| MCP del Router | `https://comand-center-1-claude-github-mcp-backup.hf.space/mcp/` | misma clave |
| Fichas vivas | `/fichas`, `/fichas/catalog`, `/fichas/{id}/run` | misma clave |
| Laboratorio | `POST /lab/run`, `GET /lab/last` | misma clave |
| Memoria / almacenamiento | `/memoria/*`, `/chat/storage`, `/chat/storage/sync` | misma clave |
| Puente HF | `/hf/status`, `/hf/models`, `/hf/datasets`, `/hf/skills`, `/hf/compute/run`, `/hf/local/serve`, `/hf/hardware` | misma clave |
| Estado del kernel | `GET /door/status` | libre (no muestra secretos) |
| Mini router L4/T4 | `https://comand-center-1-claude-github-mcp-backup.hf.space/mini/v1` (model `t4`, `l4`, `t4:<repo>`, `l4:<repo>`) | misma clave |

## Mini router (respaldo, solo HF, no depende de GitHub)
- `t4` = Job `t4-small` ($0.40/h) y `l4` = Job `l4x1` ($0.80/h); se encienden con la primera llamada (503 + Retry-After mientras carga) y se duermen a los 5 min sin llamadas.
- Tope de gasto por procesador: $5 (maximo). Al llegar se apaga y queda bloqueado hasta `POST /mini/approve {"gpu":"t4"|"l4"}` (trigger para la UI).
- Selector de costo/tiempo: `POST /mini/config {"gpu","model","cap_usd","max_minutes","idle_s"}`; estado `GET /mini/status`; apagar `POST /mini/stop`.

## Secretos del Space que usa la puerta
`RIU_KERNEL_HF_TOKEN` (lanza Jobs, lee el bucket), `RIU_VAULT_PASSPHRASE` (abre el banco dentro del Router), `RIU_AGENT_API_KEYS` / `RIU_AGENT_API_KEYS_2` (claves del Router), `RIU_ROUTER_API_KEY`.
Cambiar el procesador del Router: `POST /hf/hardware {"flavor":"cpu-upgrade","relaunch_now":true}` (el kernel lo aplica).
Handoff completo: GitHub `router inteligente universal/HANDOFF-CABLEADO.md` y `chat router/02-ARQUITECTURA/README-ARQUITECTURA.md`.
El antiguo relanzador por webhook se elimino: el micro-kernel es el unico que lanza el Router (un solo Router).

## Raiz unica, candado y conexion universal (2026-10-03 noche)

- Almacenamiento: todo el Router vive en `yaiwes-memoria-storage/router-inteligente-universal/` (memoria, banco, laboratorio, control, codigo, fichas, espacios, `Ventana status router inteligente universal/`). El respaldo T4/L4 vive aparte en `yaiwes-memoria-storage/router-respaldo/` (estado + `LEEME-HANDOFF.md`).
- Candado: cambiar costo/tiempo del respaldo (`/mini/config`) y aprobar gasto (`/mini/approve`) exige la cabecera `X-Director-Key`. Se compara contra la huella `RIU_DIRECTOR_KEY_HASH` (secreto del Space); la clave no se guarda.
- Tokens de agente (`riu_...`, creados en el Router con la clave del Director): sirven en la puerta y en el respaldo si tienen permiso `computo`.
- Puerta: hasta 5000 conexiones simultaneas hacia el Router.
- Guia completa: GitHub `maxbry123-commits/router-universal-router-inteligente-`, rama `devin/1790824641-chat-agent-plan`, `router inteligente universal/MANUAL-AGENTES.md`.

# web-bridge — SWEN CODE free

Puente OpenAI-compatible que conduce las cuentas WEB de Qwen y DeepSeek
(chat.qwen.ai / chat.deepseek.com) desde un Space HF scale-to-zero.

## Flujo
- `POST /v1/chat/completions` con `model`:
  - `web-dsv4-flash` | `web-qwen37max` | `web-qwen38max` → objetivo directo
  - `swecode-consulta` / `swecode-plan` → fan-out a los 3 + síntesis Qwen3.8Max
  - `swecode-revision|solucion|arquitectura|archivos|prompt_code` → objetivo único
- Entrada grande → bloques `[BLOQUE n/N · MODO X]` (~2500 chars) + `checkpoint.json`
  en `BRIDGE_STATE_DIR` (montar dataset permanente) → retoma tras reinicio.
- Sesión caída → login con cuenta actual; falla → rota al siguiente correo
  (`WEB_ACCOUNTS`, misma `WEB_PASS`). Errores tipados: `SESSION_EXPIRED`,
  `SELECTOR_BROKEN`, `INPUT_NO_ENCONTRADO`.
- `POST /refresh_session` → chequea sesiones vivas (herramienta nativa del agente).

## Secrets del Space
`WEB_ACCOUNTS` (correos separados por coma), `WEB_PASS`, `BRIDGE_PROXY` (opcional).

## Pendiente honesto
- Los selectores `@@` en `src/sites.js` son candidatos genéricos: calibrarlos
  contra la página real en el primer arranque (la web cambia su DOM seguido).
- Login inicial por correo+clave vía script; si el sitio pide captcha/2FA,
  hay que resolverlo una vez manual (fallback: proxy residencial en `BRIDGE_PROXY`).

## Variables (sin valores; configurar como Secrets)
- `WEB_ACCOUNTS`
- `WEB_PASS`
- `BRIDGE_PROXY` (opcional)

Dataset `COMAND-CENTER-1/swe-code-hf-gguf` montado en `/data` (state en `/data/state`).
